title: Push
description: For push notifications, you must provide at least one of `subject` or `body`.

recipients.description: Filter conditions that define the newsletter's recipients. Combine `segment` and `attribute` conditions with `and`, `or`, and `not` operators.

and.description: An array of conditions that must all be true.

or.description: An array of conditions where at least one must be true.

not.description: A condition or group of conditions to exclude.

value.description: The value to compare against. Required when `operator` is `eq`.

inverse.description: Set to `true` for "is not equal" or "does not exist".

send_now.description: If `true`, the newsletter is sent immediately after creation. You cannot set both `send_now` and `scheduled_at`.

scheduled_at.description: A Unix timestamp indicating when to send the newsletter. The time must be in the future. You cannot set both `send_now` and `scheduled_at`.

subscription_topic_id.description: The newsletter audience's subscription topic ID. Required when [subscription center](/journeys/channels/subscriptions/center/#enable-sub-center) is enabled; otherwise sends to globally subscribed profiles.

allOf.description: Optional newsletter rate limiting. If you set `rate_limit_email_rate` or `rate_limit_time_period`, set both; `rate_limit_spread` can be set alone.

rate_limit_email_rate.description: Maximum number of messages per time period. **NOTE:** Though this states `email_rate`, you can use this for other message channels. Only fixed rate limits are supported, not [daily ramp limits](/journeys/send/broadcasts/newsletters/#daily-ramp).

rate_limit_time_period.description: Time period in seconds for rate limiting. Must be one of 60 (minute), 3600 (hour), or 86400 (day).

rate_limit_spread.description: When `true`, spreads messages evenly across the time period. Otherwise, it sends as fast as possible up to the limit in each period.

type.description: The channel type for the newsletter.

subject.description: The title of the push notification. You must provide `subject`, `body`, or both.

body.description: The body content of the push notification. You must provide `subject`, `body`, or both.
